decisions.reason: The new reference to dedicated location pages could describe pages on the master site or destinations hosted by the existing separate Wix websites; the source does not safely resolve whether the separate-website model changed.
Homepage location routing does not change the requirement for separate location calendars or establish a different calendar placement.
The source changes visitor-facing location discovery but does not state that separate Wix accounts are consolidated or otherwise changed.
The source message's domain change is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, and the location-routing change requires no additional domain-state update.

The selector now names Linden Falls, Port Averly, and Ridgehaven rather than Harbor Valley, but the source does not explicitly end the legacy-site transition or say whether a separate Harbor Valley link must be removed.
The source message's expansion and reusable-location-design changes are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Adding homepage routing to dedicated location pages does not change the established rule that bookings remain separately handled by the related location websites.
The visitor-routing decision does not alter separate payouts or location-specific payment setups.
The source does not change where payments are processed or whether each location retains its own payment setup.
Homepage location selection and dedicated pages do not change the independently established separation of location reporting, revenue, and sales tracking.
The branding changes in the source message are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the routing change adds no further brand-state change.
The mobile-friendly requirement is already introduced from this source message and is not further changed by the location-routing decision.
